title: DeliveryRateLibrary
description: How densely a vocal can carry syllables. Each profile supplies the syllables-per-line band that the writing brief states, and the two syllables-per-second ceilings that decide whether what was written actually fits the time. The band is where good writing usually sits; the ceiling is where the clock runs out, and they are deliberately separate numbers.

derivation.description: How the numbers were arrived at, so a later reader can tell a calibrated estimate from a guess.

default.description: Profile id used when nothing selects one.

band.description: Inclusive syllables-per-line guidance for this delivery.

comfortable_max.description: Syllables per second above which the delivery starts to sound rushed.

hard_max.description: Syllables per second above which the section cannot hold the words in the time available.
